title: Creative Twist Events

services.name: Party package
services.desc: Creative Twist Events provides corporate event planning for all of your companies needs. We have over 20 years of experience in corporate and association meeting planning. You can hire us to plan your meeting from start to finish or for just a part of it. We source destinations, hotel and vendor contracts, food and beverage, audio-visual, special events, DMC’s, dinners, transportation and budget management. We celebrate everything! CTE will help you plan your companies successes, employees personal achievements, anniversaries, birthdays, retirements and holidays. We design special events to fit your companies, look, feel and culture. Are you launching a new product, restaurant or business?
